title: Clove in Mauritius
content:
## Post Harvest technology
Cloves flower around Sept - Oct, Dec - Jan depending on certain regions. Clove buds form on young branches and take 4-6months to become ready. Buds become yellowish from green. A 15 or 20 year old yields around 3 to 4 kg clove. 15-20% volatile oil can be produced from dried bugs
